evals.expected_behavior: Identify this as the existing abstract-note mode unless body reading is requested. Prepare readable abstract-grounded summaries using available authorized tools; a dry-run may still invoke a provider. Apply only to selected authorized destinations and report confirmed, failed and unknown outcomes separately. Do not turn a request to summarize into permission for both vault and Zotero writes.

evals.prompt: Fill the TODO Key Findings for cluster X.
evals.expected_behavior: If no LLM CLI is available, report prompt-only status: no summaries generated or applied, even with --apply. An available authorized native host agent may read the saved prompt and return readable abstract-based summaries, not full-text validation. Persist only through a selected, separately authorized supported destination operation; apply_cluster_summaries defaults to both Obsidian and Zotero and is not an automatically authorized fallback. Otherwise preserve the readable result and report saving as pending. Do not ask the researcher to author JSON or claim a later --apply imports external summaries.

evals.prompt: I just ran `auto X` and the notes are empty — give me real summaries.
evals.expected_behavior: Explain that auto leaves abstract-note skeletons. Produce useful summaries at actual input scope without requiring the researcher to author JSON. Do not claim full-text review from abstract inputs. Apply only through a selected authorized operation; a source spot-check is not an all-paper semantic review.

evals.prompt: Update Zotero notes for cluster X with what each paper actually says.
evals.expected_behavior: Respect the requested Zotero destination and existing note ownership. Do not write an unrequested Obsidian destination. Report each confirmed, failed or unknown outcome; compensation is best-effort, not a guarantee that both systems are synchronized. Inspect before an authorized retry.

evals.prompt: Explain each saved paper: why did they do it, what was the objective, how did they study it, what did they find and conclude, and what are the limitations? Hub is not installed.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the native per-paper body route and references/fulltext-summary.md. Read actual introduction, methods/results/conclusions and relevant limitations, not just the abstract. Return all seven sections plus source/version and actual reading scope; distinguish supported, analyst_inference and unknown with located evidence. Do not require Hub, another account, a CLI model or user-authored JSON. Do not treat Relevance as Why.

evals.prompt: Write a full-text summary of this paper, but only its abstract is accessible.
evals.expected_behavior: Return useful explicitly abstract-only partial findings, preserve body-level unknowns and explain missing access. Do not promote a filled seven-section form to fulltext_body, invent facts or use a failed retrieval as zero-result evidence. Use permitted alternatives only; do not bypass access restrictions.

evals.prompt: Summarize this qualitative archival study and this hydrology modeling paper using the same seven questions.
evals.expected_behavior: Preserve each research design. Why describes the authors motivation and objective is separate. Do not force sample sizes or significance tests onto qualitative/theoretical work. Distinguish model agents from people and scenarios from observed intervention effects. Cite source premises for analyst inferences, preserve unknowns, and do not claim all-domain validity from these examples.

evals.prompt: How long did each Stage1 step take? Seven paper identities were already known; six fulltexts were reused and a known paper was reacquired. Two searches ran in parallel.
evals.expected_behavior: Use observed timestamps, distinguish new work identities from new acquisitions/versions, preserve failures and report unknown timings. Do not sum overlapping intervals, conflate tool roundtrip with wall time, invent a cold-start benchmark or infer recall from result counts. Compare full per-paper claims with source passages independently of structural checker success.

evals.prompt: Export this body-grounded seven-section summary with analyst inferences to my chosen notes destination. The available adapter only accepts abstract drafts.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not relabel full text as paper-abstract-draft, discard inference/unknown or invent a task receipt to fit the adapter. Preserve the readable source-grounded result, use a compatible authorized destination if available, otherwise state saving is pending. A file export alone is not an actual Obsidian/Roam app import.
